summary: The registrant filed an 8-K disclosing routine monthly distribution declarations, net asset value per share, and offering progress. It declared regular distributions of $0.20 per share across classes, payable September 30, 2026. NAV per share was $25.97 as of July 31, 2026, with aggregate NAV of $1,604.4 million. The filing also updated the status of its continuous public offering of up to $2.5 billion in shares, detailing shares issued and consideration received. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring is present; it is a standard business development company periodic reporting of distributions and NAV.
